selection: Retain DCT, CAVLC with malformed-cache preflight fix, whole integer search and whole fractional refinement for final combined measurement.
reason: Each group has significant complete-caller component improvements. No significant regressions were observed in the fixed-size component matrix; inconclusive does not establish neutrality.
superseded: Initial cavlc-components predates malformed-cache panic-state fix. Use cavlc-fixed-components for selected implementation evidence. Initial samples retained but not pooled.
native_comparison: No new native OpenH264 speed comparison is planned. Reference conformance hashes and before/after bytes validate behavior, not native performance.
host: Active workstation; other applications and the gateway were running. Agent builds/tests are excluded from timed measurements.
full_measurement_plan: Six alternating baseline/after repetitions, ten codec cases,16 warmup+64 measured frames each. Four desktop cases,600ms each,six repetitions. No significance-seeking repeat or pooling with component runs.
